name: @workspec/site
description: The WorkSpec Studio site — focused Cost and Architecture workbenches over reviewable WorkSpec artifacts. Consumes the PUBLISHED @workspec/* packages from npm — if the site builds, those packages work for outside consumers. The @workspec/c4-* packages are (again) a temporary workspace-devDependency exception (S5, #121) until the canvas-recomposition alpha publishes — see docs/c4/drift-log.md entry 20.
_LOUD_NOTICE_devDependencies_c4_packages: The four @workspec/c4-* entries in devDependencies below are workspace:* — NOT registry pins like every other @workspec/* dependency above. This is the SECOND time the c4 family rides this deliberate, TEMPORARY exception to this app's registry-pins-only rule (the first was retired at v0.1.0-alpha.2 — drift-log entry 17; the cost family used the same shape, retired at alpha.5 — docs/cost/drift-log.md entry 1). Reinstated for S5 (#121): the S4 canvas recomposition rebuilt c4-ui on @workspec/canvas (unpublished; the C4 layer that was briefly @workspec/canvas-c4 is folded INTO c4-ui — ADR i), and c4-layout/c4-model carry unpublished changes c4-ui depends on, so the registry alpha.5 pins can no longer show the real /c4/demo. TODO(#121 follow-up): once @workspec/canvas is bootstrapped and the c4 family publishes at 0.1.0-alpha.6, flip each entry back to a registry pin in "dependencies", drop this notice, the tsconfig.json references block, and resolve drift-log entry 20 — a one-line change per package, mirroring PR #27 and PR #65.
